title: Wilt-Pruf® Concentrate | Protect Against Winter Damage, Drought, and Stress | Just Spray & Let Dry | Locks in Moisture w/Clear Foliar Film | Professional-Grade & Trusted | Replaces Burlap | (1 Gal)
features: PROTECTS PLANTS FROM MOISTURE LOSS: Stops winter damage, reduces drought stress, planting/transplanting stress and more. Dries to a soft, flexible clear film to lock in moisture. Professional grade.

WINTER DAMAGE PROTECTION: Stops damage from drying winds that damage or kill evergreen shrubs. Ideal for all evergreens including arbor vitae, cypress, azalea, rhododendrons, holly, boxwood, spruce, pine, and more. Easier and better for plants than burlap.

REPLACE BURLAP: Just spray and let dry - much easier than wrapping with unsightly brown burlap, and nothing to store in the off season. Healthy for plants - doesn't block light - supporting respiration and photosynthesis.

EXTEND LIFE OF CHRISTMAS TREES AND CUTTINGS: Preserves color and reduces needle drop. Reduces the watering requirements for cut trees. Works equally well on indoor and outdoor décor. Even keeps carved pumpkins fresh.

CONCENTRATE - ADJUST MIX RATIO: Save money and mix your own blend. Adjust the mix to the season. For winter protection use at maximum strength 1:5 (Wilt-Pruf to Water) or 1:12 (Drought). See label for additional use cases.
DROUGHT PROTECTION: Locks in moisture to reduce watering needs, reduce stress, and help keep plants healthy. Apply 2-3 times during the season. Use at 1:12 dilution rate
NEW PLANTINGS/ TRANSPLANTING PROTECTION: Reduces shock and stress. Get better growth. Keeps plants hydrated. Helps plants establish faster.

NATURAL: Made from pine resin. Wilt-Pruf does not contain plastics, so it breaks down naturally and is safe for humans, plants, and animals. Healthy for plants: supports plant growth, respiration, osmosis, and photosynthesis.
ORIGINAL MADE IN THE USA. Made in the USA since 1945. Professional Grade. The #1 choice among pros, trusted for over 70 years.

PRESERVE CARVED PUMPKINS! Wilt-Pruf seals the cut edges and inside of pumpkins to keep them fresh longer. To prevent mold, spray or soak the pumpkin in bleach solution prior to spraying with Wilt Pruf .
